senses.en: any of the large systems of stars, etc. in outer space
examples: Observations of distant [[galaxies]] indicate that they are moving away from us and the universe is expanding.

senses.en: connected with the planet Earth
examples: Technology gives us immense power over nature, and our decisions will affect all [[terrestrial]] life.

senses.en: (fml.) make it necessary for you to do sth.
examples: Sales have dropped dramatically, [[necessitating]] big cuts in production and employment.

senses.en: relating to the watching of sb. / sth. in order to learn new things
examples: We film in an [[observational]] style, following events over a period of months to see how things turn out.

senses.en: one of the things from which sth. is made, esp. one of the foods that are used together to make a particular dish
examples: Meals are prepared by the chef on board using fresh [[ingredients]] which are bought daily.

senses.en: v.travel in a curved path around a much larger object such as the Earth or the Sun
examples: The Earth is one of several planets that [[orbit]] the Sun, and the Moon [[orbits]] around the Earth.

senses.zh: （环绕地球、太阳等运行的）轨道
senses.en: n. the curved path traveled by an object which is moving around another much larger object such as the Earth or the Sun
examples: These planets have circular (环形的) [[orbits]] similar to the [[orbits]] of planets in our solar system.

senses.zh: （短暂的）旺火；（摇曳的）光；（闪耀的）火光
senses.en: a bright but unsteady light or flame that does not last long
examples: A sudden [[flare]] of light caused her to raise her right arm protectively across her face.

senses.en: vt.remove sth. that is covering the surface of sth. else
examples: I think we should [[strip]] the old paint off and see what the wood is like underneath.

senses.zh: （陆地、海域等）狭长地带；带状水域
senses.en: n.a long narrow area of land, sea, etc.
examples: The islands are separated by a narrow [[strip]] of water.

senses.en: (pl. axes) the imaginary line around which a large round object, such as the Earth, turns
examples: The Earth and many other planets in the solar system rotate on their [[axes]] and revolve around the Sun.

senses.en: (BrE stabilise) become or make sth. become firm, steady and unlikely to change
examples: He suffered a second heart attack two days ago but his condition has now [[stabilized]].

senses.en: of or related to an axis
examples: The Moon's presence also slows the [[axial]] rotation of the Earth, which is why we could have 24-hour days.

senses.en: a position in which one end or side of sth. is higher than the other; an act of tilting sth. to one side
examples: Since childhood, we have been learning the languages of the eyes, the hands and those subtle [[tilts]] of the head.

senses.en: vt.protect sb. / sth. from being harmed or damaged
examples: He wrapped himself in his heavy coat and sat in the corner where the bamboo leaves [[shielded]] him from the wind.

senses.en: n.
causing a lot of destruction, suffering, or death
examples: The movie shows heroes risking their lives to save the Earth from a [[catastrophic]] collision with a comet (彗星).

senses.en: used when you describe sth. using part of a well-known expression
examples: There are some observers who make predictions all the time about economic recessions, the collapse of civil society, and the [[proverbial]] "end of the world."

senses.en: a planet that is not in the solar system
examples: Astronomers say that this unique observing technique opens a new phase in the exploration of [[exo-planets]].

senses.en: the branch of biology that investigates the possibility of life elsewhere in the universe

senses.zh: 事先形成的看法（想法）；先入之见；成见
senses.en: a belief or opinion that you have already formed before you know the actual facts, and that may be wrong
examples: Try to go into the meeting without too many [[preconceptions]] about what the other group wants.

senses.en: of or relating to the action of water under conditions of high temperature, esp. in forming rocks and minerals

senses.zh: （空气、气体、液体的）出口，进口，漏孔
senses.en: an opening that allows air, gas or liquid to pass out of or into a room, building, container, etc.
examples: Make sure that jars have tight lids and are kept away from sunlight and heating [[vents]].

senses.en: the fact of sb. / sth. not existing or not being available; a lack of sth.
examples: The case was dismissed in the [[absence]] of any definite proof.

senses.en: when you are not in the place where people expect you to be, or the time that you are away
examples: The smell of cigarette smoke confirmed what he had suspected: There had been a party in his [[absence]].

senses.zh: 貌似有理的；似乎是真的
senses.en: reasonable and likely to be true or successful
examples: A more [[plausible]] explanation would seem to be that people are fed up with their routine life.

senses.en: (~ to sth.) making it easy, possible or likely for sth. to happen
examples: Our ultimate goal is to create a culture that is [[conducive]] to continual progress and learning.

senses.en: sth. that you must have in order to do sth. else
examples: Success in the examination did not secure by itself a postgraduate position, but it was the minimum [[requirement]].

senses.en: sth. that you need or want
examples: The average daily food [[requirement]] is about 2,000 calories for women and 2,500 for men.

senses.zh: （覆盖或连接身体某些部分的）膜；薄膜
senses.en: a very thin piece of skin that covers or connects parts of your body
examples: Exposure to loud noise from fireworks can damage the delicate [[membrane]] in the ear.

senses.en: containing water or similar to water
examples: In chemistry, an [[aqueous]] solution or cream has water as its base.

senses.en: the process by which a radioactive substance changes to a different form, producing radiation
the natural chemical change that causes the slow destruction of sth.
examples: The study did not find any association between secondhand smoke exposure and [[decay]] in permanent teeth.

senses.en: relating to or coming from the heat inside the Earth
examples: The ice sheet acts like a huge blanket that locks in the [[geothermal]] heat that comes naturally from the Earth.

senses.en: (only before noun) (of an animal) living apart from the main group, and possibly dangerous
examples: It's reported that [[rogue]] elephants have killed at least 31 people in that area this year.

senses.en: suitable for people to live in
examples: We are constantly looking for new [[habitable]] areas.

senses.en: (esp. AmE) (also enquire esp. BrE) ask sb. for some information
examples: I called the school to [[inquire]] about the application process.

senses.en: (esp. AmE) (also enquiry esp. BrE)1) the act of asking questions or collecting information about sb. / sth.
examples: On further [[inquiry]], it emerged that Malcolm had not been involved in the incident.

senses.en: an official process to find out the cause of sth. or to find out information about sth.
examples: An [[inquiry]] will be held to discover why the local school's educational record is so bad.

senses.en: (only before noun) relating to a planet or planets
examples: This means a huge step forward in understanding how [[planetary]] systems form and evolve.

senses.en: ask questions in order to find out secret or hidden information about sb. / sth.
examples: We have been [[probing]] the reasons why the government has been so slow to react to the problem of climate change.

senses.zh: 季节性的；时令的；当令的
senses.en: (usu. before noun) happening, expected, or needed during a particular season
examples: One major factor causing [[seasonal]] variations in food supplies was the difficulty of storage.

senses.en: (also periodical) (only before noun) happening a number of times, usu. at regular times
examples: Do a [[periodic]] review of your lecture notes and the relevant chapters in your textbooks.

senses.en: a person or animal that lives in a particular place
examples: According to the report, the city's first [[inhabitants]] arrived in the 16th century.

senses.en: the fact or process of noticing or discovering sth.
examples: There should be a more effective treatment for patients identified through early [[detection]].

senses.en: a quality or power that a substance, plant, etc. has
examples: For practical purposes the solar spectrum (光谱) is divided into regions with characteristic [[properties]].

senses.en: the thing or things that sb. owns
examples: Please take care of your own belongings. The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests' personal [[property]].

senses.en: (~ yourself / sb. to sth. / to doing sth.) allow yourself or sb. to have only a limited amount of sth. or to do only a particular kind of activity
examples: The senator said he would voluntarily [[restrict]] himself to $2.2 million in campaign spending.

senses.zh: 限制，限定 （大小、数量、范围等）
senses.en: limit the size, amount or range of sth.
examples: Because of limited space, the number of people who can attend the ceremony is [[restricted]] to 35.

senses.en: (only before noun) of or connected with the Sun
examples: An increase in the number of dark spots on the Sun marks a period of high [[solar]] activity.

senses.zh: 使注定（失败、死亡、毁灭等）
senses.en: (usu. passive) make sb. / sth. certain to fail, die, be destroyed, etc.
examples: A rare star system has been found in our Milky Way galaxy, but it is [[doomed]] to end in a massive explosion.

senses.zh: 地球外的；宇宙的；外星的
senses.en: relating to things that exist outside the Earth
examples: Over the years, we've been conditioned to accept the possibility of [[extraterrestrial]] life through movies and reports about alien encounters.

senses.zh: 木星（太阳系中最大的行星）
